svg.title: Defeat of the Spanish Armada: Channel Battles, Fireships, Gravelines and Atlantic Wrecks (May–October 1588)
svg.desc: High-precision 1:10m GIS historical atlas map of the 1588 Spanish Armada campaign across the Bay of Biscay, English Channel, North Sea, Scotland, and Ireland, plotting Corunna, Lizard Point and Plymouth, Portland Bill and the Isle of Wight, Calais fireships and Dunkirk blockade, the Battle of Gravelines, the northward 'Protestant Wind' retreat around Fair Isle, and over 25 Spanish shipwrecks along Scotland and Ireland.

text.tspan: 3. Portland Bill & Isle of Wight (2–4 Aug)
8 Fireships Cut Anchors; Parma Trapped Ashore
